summary: Cloudflare-native Linear Agent. A Hono Worker terminates Linear AgentSession + Issue webhooks, drives long-running engine runs via a Cloudflare Workflow (SessionRunner), and HMAC-signs requests to a sibling sandbox-dispatcher Worker that runs pi/claude/codex inside Cloudflare Sandbox containers built on the @cloudflare/sandbox SDK.

linear-agent.purpose: Receives Linear webhooks, owns OAuth + DB state, dispatches sandbox runs, hosts the dashboard SPA + REST/MCP APIs.

bindings.LINEAR_TOKENS: KV — OAuth state nonces + webhook delivery dedupe markers (60-min TTL)
bindings.DISPATCH_HMAC_SECRET: secret — shared with sandbox-dispatcher; signs every /run + /run/stop body
bindings.LINEAR_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/WEBHOOK_SECRET: secrets — Linear OAuth app + webhook signing
bindings.CREDENTIAL_KEK: secret — base64 AES-256 master key for envelope-encrypting org_credentials
bindings.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: secret — signs Better Auth session cookies + CSRF
bindings.GITHUB_APP_ID/PRIVATE_KEY/SLUG/SETTINGS_: secrets — Symphony GitHub App for minting per-org install tokens
bindings.GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/SECRET: secrets — GitHub OAuth user login (separate from GitHub App)
bindings.DEFAULT_ENGINE/MODEL/MAX_TURNS/SCOPE: vars — worker-wide floor for engine resolution chain

scheduled_cron.purpose: Belt-and-suspenders for SessionRunner in-band terminal cleanup. Catches sessions stuck in `running` (D1 outage during catch block, force-terminated instances). See src/lib/reconciler.ts.

routes.purpose: Better Auth — sign-in, sign-up, social, organization, session.
Linear webhook receiver — verifies HMAC, dedupes, routes AgentSessionEvent → SESSION_RUNNER, Issue → workflow resolver + dispatchTrigger. Logs every delivery to webhook_events.
routes.sla: ack within 5s, first agent activity within 10s

routes.purpose: OAuth callback — exchanges code, upserts linear_agent_installs.
Redirect to GitHub App install URL.
GitHub App install callback — upserts github_installs.
Workflow CRUD: list, get, create, update, delete, publish, duplicate, preview, resolve, +/triggers nested.
Org-scoped key/value settings. Curated keys: agent.default_engine, agent.default_model, agent.max_turns; others accepted as-is.
Bearer API token CRUD (hashed at rest).

Model Context Protocol Streamable-HTTP transport. Tools dispatch into v1 REST via synthetic Request. Bearer-only. Tools: workflows.*, triggers.*, projects.*, settings.*, integrations.status, webhook_events.*, openapi.get.
Serves SPA index.html (Vite-built React app). Login/signup/setup routes also catch-all to index.
Dashboard session list, live SSE, debug payload, rerun.
Integrations panel: Linear/GitHub status, per-org BYO credential writes.
Proxy Linear GraphQL teams list for project setup.
List installed-app accessible repos for project repo picker.
Org settings — surfaces agent_defaults (env.DEFAULT_*) on GET.

d1_tables.accounts: Better Auth per-user OAuth/social provider link (email/password creds, GitHub, Linear actor=user).
d1_tables.linear_agent_installs: Per-org `actor=app` Linear install token (access + refresh + expires_at). Unique on linear_organization_id — webhook entry point.
d1_tables.github_installs: Per-org Symphony GitHub App install. Used to mint per-run installation tokens via JWT.
d1_tables.projects: Per-Linear-team project config: repo_url, default_branch, scope. (engine/model/max_turns columns exist but are ignored by the runner — see resolution chain.)
d1_tables.agent_sessions: One row per Agent Session run. Holds status, prompt, config_snapshot, error.
d1_tables.agent_session_events: Streaming timeline (per-event row) appended live during SessionRunner.runTurn.
d1_tables.org_credentials: Per-org BYO secrets, envelope-encrypted (DEK wrapped by KEK; kek_version tracked).
d1_tables.workflows: Trigger-fired workflow defs: engine, model, max_turns, prompt_template (Liquid), allowed/disallowed_tools, permission_mode, status (draft/published).
d1_tables.workflow_triggers: Many-per-workflow trigger rules (event_type, state filters, label filters, scope filters, priority).
d1_tables.api_tokens: Bearer tokens (sha256 at rest), scoped per-org with optional per-scope ACL.
d1_tables.webhook_events: Every webhook delivery — signature ok flag, raw body (truncated 64KB), dispatchedAction, eventSummary, latency.

src_layout.src/index.ts: Hono app factory, Env interface, fetch + scheduled handlers, re-export of SessionRunner.
src_layout.src/workflows/session-runner.ts: Cloudflare Workflow driving a single Agent Session: load-token → post-initial-thought → resolve-inputs → turn-N loop (SSE stream from dispatcher, persists every event to agent_session_events, posts live Linear activities) → post-terminal-activity → record-session-end. Has two modes: `agent_session` (Linear-visible) and `trigger` (headless). Outer try/finally always calls dispatcher.stop() to tear down the per-issue sandbox.
src_layout.src/routes/webhook.ts: Linear webhook receiver. AgentSessionEvent path: create/resume SESSION_RUNNER instance keyed on agentSession.id; `prompted` with signal:stop terminates + cleans up. Issue path: map → resolveWorkflow → dispatchTrigger.
src_layout.src/routes/api-v1.ts: REST API surface for workflows, triggers, projects, settings, webhook events, api tokens, integrations.
src_layout.src/routes/mcp.ts: MCP Streamable-HTTP transport. Tools dispatch into the v1 router via synthetic Requests.
src_layout.src/routes/github.ts: Symphony GitHub App install + per-org credential management.
src_layout.src/routes/openapi.ts: Builds OpenAPI 3.1 doc from route shapes.
src_layout.src/lib/dispatcher.ts: HMAC-signed client for sandbox-dispatcher. POST /run + /run/stop. Exposes runStream() that yields NormalizedEvents from an SSE stream, terminating on `result`. Pinned HMAC test vector matches Elixir signer.
src_layout.src/lib/dispatch-trigger.ts: Resolves project, renders Liquid prompt, refreshes install token, mints Linear AgentSession on issue, queues SESSION_RUNNER with synthetic webhook envelope + workflow_overrides snapshot.
src_layout.src/lib/activities.ts: Linear AgentActivity wrappers (postThought/postResponse/postError/postElicitation/postAction), createAgentSessionOnIssue mutation, refresh-on-401 client.
src_layout.src/lib/agent-viewer.ts: Cached lookup of `viewer { id }` per Linear org (for issue delegate).
src_layout.src/lib/auth.ts: Better Auth factory — email/password, GitHub OAuth, Linear genericOAuth, organization+teams plugin. Drizzle adapter on D1.
src_layout.src/lib/auth/bearer.ts: Bearer extraction + sha256 hashing for api_tokens.
src_layout.src/lib/auth/context.ts: requireAuth middleware: session cookie OR bearer.
src_layout.src/lib/credentials.ts: CredentialStore — envelope encryption (random DEK per row, KEK wraps DEK). AES-GCM-256 throughout.
src_layout.src/lib/event-mapper-inbound.ts: Map Linear Issue webhook → normalized EventTuple[]: state_entered (uses data.state.name), label_added (per added label, names resolved via labels[]).
src_layout.src/lib/event-mapper.ts: Map dispatcher NormalizedEvent → Linear AgentActivityContent for live timeline.
src_layout.src/lib/github-app.ts: Mint per-installation token using GitHub App JWT (RS256, 10-min TTL).
src_layout.src/lib/github.ts: Helpers for repo metadata + PR creation.
src_layout.src/lib/install-token.ts: refreshInstallToken + refreshInstallTokenIfNeeded — rotates Linear actor=app OAuth tokens against expires_at safety window.
src_layout.src/lib/linear-token.ts: resolveLinearMcpToken — prefers per-user accounts.accessToken, falls back to install access_token. Delivered to sandbox as LINEAR_API_TOKEN env.
src_layout.src/lib/pagination.ts: parsePagination + nextCursorFrom for cursor-paginated list endpoints.
src_layout.src/lib/prompts/linear-graphql.ts: Appends a 'use the linear skill' marker block to every prompt with the issue/team UUIDs the skill needs.
src_layout.src/lib/reconciler.ts: Zombie session reconciler — scans agent_sessions stuck in `running` past timeout, marks them errored.
src_layout.src/lib/settings.ts: buildAgentDefaults (from env.DEFAULT_*) + validateSettingValue for curated keys.
src_layout.src/lib/store.ts: D1 repository classes: LinearAgentInstallStore, GitHubInstallStore, ProjectStore, AgentSessionStore, AgentSessionEventStore, WebhookEventStore, SettingStore.
src_layout.src/lib/workflows/resolver.ts: Resolves best (workflow, trigger) for an EventTuple via SQL JOIN ordered by scope_tier (user > team > org) then priority DESC.
src_layout.src/lib/workflows/seed.ts: ensureDefaultWorkflow — lazy-seeds Engineering Default workflow on first webhook for an org.
src_layout.src/schemas/*.ts: Zod schemas (validated at REST + MCP boundaries) for api-token, event, project, trigger, workflow.
src_layout.src/db/auth.schema.ts: Drizzle bindings for Better Auth tables.
src_layout.src/types/agent-session.ts: AgentSessionEventWebhook + AgentActivityContent types (mirror Linear's JSON shapes).

routes: /sessions/$sessionId → session-by-id.tsx (canonical UUID URL — matches Linear externalUrls link)
/projects → projects.tsx (project CRUD with Linear team + GitHub repo pickers)

engine_resolution_chain.note: Snapshot of workflow.engine/model/max_turns + allowed_tools/disallowed_tools/permission_mode at dispatch time. Frozen — mid-run workflow edits don't perturb in-flight. NULL workflow.model means inherit (field omitted).

external_dependencies.name: sandbox-dispatcher

key_patterns.webhook_dedupe: KV-backed 60-min markers per (webhookId, agentSessionId) or (webhookId, issueId, webhookTimestamp).
key_patterns.workflow_instance_id_collision: SESSION_RUNNER instance id = Linear agentSession.id — Linear retries collide on existing instance idempotently.
key_patterns.in_band_token_refresh: Single-flight per orgId; on 401 the Linear GraphQL helper retries once with a fresh token after refreshInstallToken.
key_patterns.envelope_encryption: Random per-row DEK (AES-GCM-256), wrapped by KEK (also AES-GCM-256, stored as Workers secret). kek_version column supports rotation.
key_patterns.hmac_wire_compat: test-vector pinned in dispatcher.test.ts, sandbox-dispatcher hmac.ts, and Elixir DispatcherClient — drift breaks all three suites loudly.
key_patterns.rest_mcp_unification: MCP tool handlers dispatch into the v1 REST router via synthetic Requests — no parallel implementation.
key_patterns.stop_signal_path: `prompted` webhook with signal:stop is handled fully in the webhook route (terminate Workflow instance + dispatcher.stop + post final response + DB update) because Cloudflare Workflow `finally` doesn't run reliably after terminate().
key_patterns.sandbox_branch_naming: Per-issue branch derived as `symphony/<lowercased-sanitized-identifier>` for continuity across multiple runs on the same issue.

sandbox-sdk-skill.trigger: Loaded when building AI code execution, code interpreters, CI/CD systems, interactive dev environments, or executing untrusted code.
covers: @cloudflare/sandbox SDK install + wrangler config (containers + durable_objects + migrations)
Sandbox lifecycle (getSandbox, destroy, sleepAfter, keepAlive, normalizeId)
Code interpreter — sandbox.createCodeContext + runCode (python/javascript/typescript), rich outputs
Port exposure — exposePort/unexposePort/listPorts (preview URLs need custom wildcard domain)
Dockerfile extension on docker.io/cloudflare/sandbox:0.7.0 (Python 3.11, Node 20 baseline)
OpenAI Agents SDK integration via @cloudflare/sandbox/openai (Shell, Editor)
Anti-patterns: internal client misuse, missing Sandbox export, hardcoded ids, missing destroy()
sandbox-sdk-skill.relationship_to_linear_agent: Conceptually upstream: the sandbox-dispatcher Worker (sibling to linear-agent — not in this scope) is built on this SDK. linear-agent never imports @cloudflare/sandbox directly; it only HMAC-signs requests to the dispatcher. The skill is the reference future contributors load when editing dispatcher code or per-engine baseline snapshots.

linear_mention_to_pr: 1. User @-mentions agent in Linear → Linear POSTs AgentSessionEvent.created to /webhook.
2. webhook route verifies HMAC, dedupes on (webhookId, sessionId) in LINEAR_TOKENS KV, inserts webhook_events row.
3. SESSION_RUNNER.create({id: agentSession.id, params:{mode:'agent_session', event}}) — Workflow instance keyed on session id.
4. Workflow step load-token: refreshInstallTokenIfNeeded against expires_at; returns access_token + githubInstall id.
5. Workflow step post-initial-thought: postThought via activities client (refresh-on-401).
6. Workflow step start-session-side-effects: set issue delegate to agent viewer, set externalUrls to /dashboard/sessions/<id>, post initial 2-item plan.
7. Workflow step resolve-inputs: ProjectStore.getByTeamId → repo_url; resolvePrompt(promptContext|comment|description); resolve engine/model/max_turns via chain; append Linear GraphQL skill marker.
8. Workflow step record-session-start: AgentSessionStore.create with config_snapshot.

9. Turn loop (1..max_turns): resolve LinearMcpToken (per-user from accounts > install token); call dispatcher.runStream() — POST /run with X-Symphony-Signature, Accept: text/event-stream. For each NormalizedEvent: persistEvent → agent_session_events row, mapToActivity → linear.createAgentActivity (live timeline). On turn_end:needs_continuation, build continuation prompt and loop. On `result`, exit.
10. step.waitForEvent('linear.prompted', timeout: 25m) — bounded wait for follow-up `prompted` webhook between turn batches; webhook route forwards via instance.sendEvent.
11. post-terminal-activity: postResponse or postError. update-final-plan. record-session-end (status=completed/error). Outer finally: dispatcher.stop(issueId).
trigger_initiated_workflow: 3. ensureDefaultWorkflow(orgId) — idempotent seed on first delivery.
4. For each EventTuple: resolveWorkflow → single best (workflow, trigger) by scope_tier+priority.
5. dispatchTrigger: resolve project (repo_url), render Liquid prompt_template with issue context, refreshInstallTokenIfNeeded, createAgentSessionOnIssue → linearSessionId.
6. Build synthetic AgentSessionEvent (action:created, type:AgentSessionEvent, promptContext: rendered prompt).
7. SESSION_RUNNER.create with mode:agent_session + workflow_overrides snapshot (engine, model, max_turns, name, allowed/disallowed_tools, permission_mode).
8. Same Workflow flow as @-mention runs — Linear timeline shows it identically.
stop_signal: 2. webhook route detects via extractStopSignal (probes 3 paths).
3. SESSION_RUNNER.get(sessionId).terminate() — finally NOT trusted to run.
5. postResponse('Stopped at user request.') to Linear timeline.
